1. Integer Arithmetic Instructions

1.1. Integer Arithmetic Instructions: alpha

Syntax

alpha.type d, a, b;
.type = { .u32, .u64 };

Alpha is independently defined.

1.2. Integer Arithmetic Instructions: beta

beta.u32 d, a, b;

Beta may use integer operand rules.

1.3. Integer Arithmetic Instructions: gamma

gamma.u32 d, a;

Gamma is independently defined.

2. Integer Operand Rules

integer operand
An operand whose declared type is integral.
